tools.name: list_neighborhoods
tools.description: Every neighborhood on Kiawah, Seabrook or Johns Island. Kiawah and Seabrook: every neighborhood and villa regime — type, area, regime manager, MLS sales since 2021 and the median price per square foot over the last 24 months where five or more sales allow. Facts about places only.

tools.name: get_neighborhood
tools.description: One neighborhood's record. Kiawah and Seabrook: sourced facts (each with who published it), regime manager, the county's homes and lots, its MLS sales by year, the living-CMA price-per-square-foot range, what it costs to own (fee ledger lines) and the page URL.

tools.name: island_market
tools.description: Kiawah, Seabrook or Johns Island: the last 12 months of residential sales island-wide from the MLS's own statistics (every island). tools.name: estimate_range
tools.description: Arithmetic, not a price opinion: the middle half of closed-sale price per square foot (25th–75th percentile) for a complex, or for attached or detached homes island-wide, times the given heated square feet. For a real CMA, send the person to request_contact.

tools.name: fees
tools.description: The fee ledger for Kiawah, Seabrook or Johns Island: each buyer, owner and rental charge with its amount, who charges it, how sure it is (confirmed / secondary / conflicting / not published), its source and the date it was checked.

tools.name: request_contact
tools.description: Sends the person's question to Mike Olson, a licensed South Carolina real estate agent with eXp Realty, LLC. Only call this when the person asked you to. It never carries consent to calls or texts — Mike emails the person himself to confirm before anything else.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_neighborhood, happenings · Private data: get_neighborhood, request_contact · Public sink: island_market, estimate_range.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_neighborhood, happenings · Private data: get_neighborhood, request_contact · Public sink: island_market, estimate_range

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
